top_signals.title: Global bond yields soar to multi-decade highs as Middle East turmoil reignites inflation fears
top_signals.summary: Bond yields surged across major markets Tuesday as U.S.-Iran hostilities revived energy and inflation risks, with Japan and U.K. yields at multi-decade highs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Green notice 2026/02
top_signals.summary: Green notices cover significant and/or significant proposals for Bank of England reporting. If any of these proposals are finalised and are to be implemented, they will appear in a statistical notice.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.summary: Given at the World Resources Institute, London
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
